description: Takes a screenshot of the active tab and returns it as an image the model can see. Captures the full scrollable page by default, including pages that scroll inside a panel. Use it to check layout, verify a fix visually, or see what the user is describing.

mode.description: "full" stitches the whole page, "viewport" takes only what is on screen.

viewport.description: Render the page at a breakpoint before capturing. "current" uses the window as it is.

name: capture_page
title: Capture the page
